segments.text: Ok so this is the Threads Drawer page for Google Antigravity with Angular, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, the page says the drawer shows a locked state when threads aren't available.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
Moving on to the demo. It should list the conversations, or at least show the locked state, but the drawer is just an empty panel.
So basically, the drawer should list threads or show it's locked.
It shows nothing, and the page never says what has to serve the threads list.
That's the problem here, please have a look.
